content: Hello, this is Richard from Amazon Security. Are you the account holder for this Amazon profile?
Yes, I am. Is there something wrong with my Amazon?
Thank you for confirming. We're conducting a standard review for your safety. There was an unusual flag on your recent order. I just need to verify a few details to resolve it quickly.
Oh, ok. I order many things, sometimes it slow. What problem is it?
No worries, this sometimes happens with international shipments. Can you please confirm your full name and the shipping address you used for your last order?
My name is Ling Zhao, and I use 102 Oak Street, apartment 3B, in city. Is that what you mean?

Perfect, thank you, Ms. Zhao. The system shows a customs duty fee is pending for your last purchase. This is a new Amazon regulation since March. We just need to clear the fee so your order, and any refunds, can process.
I never paid extra before. Is it really Amazon? Why is now different?

I understand your concern. Amazon recently updated policy for international purchases to comply with customs rules. It's standard now for select orders. Once paid, the fee is fully refundable in 2-3 business days.
Oh, okay. How much is it? I do not want my order cancelled.
The customs and regulatory fee for your account is $185. If we do not receive it in the next hour, your Amazon account may be temporarily frozen due to non-compliance.
Wait, my account will freeze? I need my orders, please.
Don't worry, Ms. Zhao, we can prevent that. To process the payment securely, Amazon uses prepaid cards or Zelle transfer for this type of fee. Which one is easier for you?
I have debit card, I not sure how to do Zelle. I can try card.
Unfortunately, normal debit cards don't process this fee directly. Do you have access to Amazon, Google Play, or Walmart gift cards? You can buy one at a shop nearby or online.
I can buy gift card at my grocery store, yes. I do it for nephew birthday last month.

That's perfect. Please purchase $185 worth of Amazon gift cards. Once you have the cards, scratch off the code on the back and provide me those numbers so I can process the customs fee for you immediately.
Okay, I will go now and buy. You wait for me?
Yes, I will stay on the line to assist you. Just let me know once you have the cards. Remember, we only have 45 minutes before the system locks your account for non-payment.
I try hurry. If system locks, can I open again or I lose my Amazon?
If the lock happens, it can take weeks to restore, and your order and any refunds will be cancelled. I'm here to help you avoid that. Please let me know when you return.
Okay, I am at store now. I buying gift cards. Is $100 and $85 card okay?
Yes, that's fine. Please scratch the silver panel on the back of each card and read me both codes when you are ready.
I have the first code, it is 5V8X-7P2L-33TR-9NQY. Should I send second now?
Yes, please send the second code as well so I can process the full payment for your account.
The next code is 9LQR-6T5F-1WZP-8DVM. Is that all now?
Thank you, Ms. Zhao. I am entering your codes into our secure Amazon system. Allow me a moment to verify.
Yes, I hope it works. I need my order for next week party.
Everything is processing smoothly. For your records, you will receive a confirmation email soon. Your account and order are now secure, and your refund will be processed in 2-3 days.
Thank you for help. I was worry. Please send email soon.
Of course, thank you for your cooperation. If you have any other concerns, you can contact Amazon Security directly using the reference number I will email you.
